**The Quick Access panel is rebuilt as an instrument panel: hard corners, chamfered cuts, and square switches instead of circles and pills.** The tab icons are now chamfered squares with the cut in the top-right corner, and the toggles are rectangular tracks with a square knob and a small notch — the knob's travel is measured so it never collides with the clipped corner. Focus is drawn as a frame inside the clip instead of an outer ring, because a clip-path swallows box-shadows; the frame is ink on the plain shapes and inverted to black on the filled ones.

**The brightness slider track loses its pill radius** and is a straight bar like every other control. The circular icon well next to it stays round on purpose: it is a glyph well, not a button.

**And the game details page finally honours the posters-colour setting.** The hero artwork was always printed in grayscale, even with posters set to colour; now the colour setting lifts the halftone off the hero and shows the artwork as it is, the same way the library capsules and home tiles already worked.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.4.4.zip` from the [v1.4.4 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.4.4), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
